title: The Adventure Begins

title: A Forest Far Beyond the Familiar
description: Previous: [The Adventure Begins](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519019) Next: [The Heroes of Ballymolloy](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=519122) Quest Steps: - Speak to the people of [Ballymolloy](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519023). - Head to the [mine](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519030) to the south-east of Ballymolloy and find a green gem for Patrick. - Search for a [green gem](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519050) in the mine. - Bring the green gem back to Patrick in Ballymolloy. - Go and see how Patrick's father is faring. - Go north from Ballymolloy then head east to take on the monsters in the [tower](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519052). - Head to the tower in the east and defeat the leader of the monsters. - Go and talk to Patrick and Hanlon. - Head to [the forest](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519022) and see if you can find a way to get back to Estard. - Head back home. - Meet up with Kiefer. - Head deeper into the shrine. - Head to the island that's appeared out of nowhere. - Look around [Ballymolloy](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=519116).

title: An Enormous Eruption
description: Previous: [The Heroes of Ballymolloy](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=519122) Next: [A Disaster Brewing in Burnmont](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=519271) Quest Steps: - Find [the village](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519198) and see if the vision you saw was real. - Speak to the people of Emberdale. - There's something going on by the well in Emberdale. Go and take a closer look. - Go and speak to Palmela in the establishment known as the Trading Post. - Rest up at the [Flaming Flagon Arms](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519200), the inn in Emberdale. - Speak to Gaffer of Emberdale. - Speak to Palmela in the Trading Post in Emberdale. - Enjoy the sights and sounds of the Flaming Festival. - Participate in the Return of Fire Ritual. - Join the Gaffer at the top of Burnmont. - See what's happening in the belly of Burnmont. - Descend deep into the bowels of the mountain and find out what's going on. - Head back up to the crater at the top of Burnmont. - Now that the boulder has been removed, use the [teleportal](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519194) to get back to Estard. - Head back to [Estard Castle](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=518908) and find out if any new islands have appeared. - It's time to hit the hay. - Investigate the newly discovered island. - Head to the Shoreside Shrine. - Think of a way to move the rock in the shrine.

title: Strange Animals, Stranger People
description: Previous: [A Disaster Brewing in Burnmont](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=519271) Next: [Ruff and Ready](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=519645) Quest Steps: - Have a nose around the town and see what you can find. - Spend the night in the [inn](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519454). - Find out what's going on in the town. - Free the boy chained up in the barn in [L'Arca](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519451). - Follow the wolf boy. - Leave the town and follow the wolf boy. - Follow the wolf boy and head west from L'Arca. - Follow the wolf boy into [the cave](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519468). - The wolf boy's trying to tell you something. Look closely at the part of the cliff covered in ivy. - Head through the secret entrance to the Grotta del Sigillo. - Head further into the Grotta del Sigillo. - Find where the wolf boy has run off to. - Use the [teleportal](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519449) to travel back to Estard. - Visit the island that has now appeared. - Explore the new island. - See what you can find in the [Grotta del Sigillo](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=519611).

title: An Invasion of Automata
description: Previous: [Ruff and Ready](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=519645) Next: [Automata Through the Ages](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=519832) Quest Steps: - Head south-west of [Frobisher](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519649) and pay a visit to [Faraday Castle](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519670). - Go to the throne room of Faraday Castle and introduce yourself to the King. - Head to the lookout tower at the top of the castle and report for duty. - Head west from the castle and find Autonymus in the [Royal Institute of Automatry](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519712). - Speak to Autonymus in the Royal Institute of Automatry. - Head back to Faraday Castle. - Head to Frobisher with Autonymus to see if you can salvage some spare parts. - Investigate the damaged automata in Frobisher and collect the spare parts you need. - [Globular Pistotron](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519721) - [Globular Pistotron](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519722) - [Globular Pistotron](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519723) - Head back to Faraday Castle. - Secure the main entrance to the castle. - Head to the Royal Institute of Automatry and tell Thaddeus and Autonymus what's going on. - Head back to Faraday Castle. - Go and talk to Kiefer in front of the main castle entrance. - Meet Thaddeus in the officers' mess in Faraday Castle. - Get ready for battle, then report to Thaddeus and Autonymus in the guards' quarters. - Follow Thaddeus and Autonymus. - Head to the [Automaton Stronghold](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519726) to the north-east of Frobisher. - Head into the Automaton Stronghold and find out who's behind all of this. - Make your way back to Faraday Castle and report to the King. - Use the [teleportal](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/past?locationIds=519648) to travel back to Estard. - Visit the island that has now appeared. - See if you can find a town or village in the vicinity. - Take a look around [Faraday Castle](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=519781). - title: Little Devil Heart
description: Location: Inside a treasure chest on the small cliff ledge Effect: The mental alertness to always know when it's time to pop a single phial

title: Healslime Heart
description: Location: Inside a treasure chest at the end of a side tunnel Effect: The devoted mindset of one who always wants to help and heal, no matter who, no matter when

title: Swagman Heart
description: Location: Inside the left treasure chest in the small locked room Effect: The certain conviction that all will be well if there's powerful healing to be had

title: Goodybag Heart
description: Location: Inside a treasure chest against the wall of the room Effect: The spirit of a stuff-strutter who can send the entire dancefloor into the stratosphere

title: Skeleton Swordsman Heart
description: Location: Inside a treasure chest against the wall of the room between two obelisks Effect: The know-how to make each consecutive strike ever stronger, whether you have two arms or six

title: Infanticore Heart
description: Location: Inside a treasure chest at the edge of a ledge partway up the tower Effect: The dastardly disposition to delight in making their fellow fiends tremble with fear

title: Notso Macho Heart
description: Location: In Multipleximus Maximus inside a treasure chest on final platform in area two Effect: A gambler's mentality in which any crisis can become a chance to succeed

title: Togre Heart
description: Location: On the ground against the back wall of the room after returning later in the story Effect: The certainty of knowing that the secret of success is simple - stick 'em with a status ailment!

title: Wight Watchman Heart
description: Location: On the ground on the middle of the island against the wall of the pit Effect: The courage to strike with confidence against any enemy, as long as their back is turned

title: Liquid Metal Slime Heart
description: Location: Rewarded for turning in 45 mini medals Effect: The metallic mettle of one who will never bend or break

title: Metal King Slime Heart
description: Location: Rewarded for turning in 60 mini medals Effect: A metal monarch's majestic magnetism - always attractive to similarly steely souls

title: Drakulard Heart
description: Location: Inside the right treasure chest in the cell Effect: A colossus's uncomplicated cast of mind - the more HP, the better

title: Xenlon Heart
description: Location: Inside the treasure chest dropped by [Xenlon](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=525449) after defeating it Effect: The mentality of a mythic dragon that endured for eons to earn its almighty power

title: Numen Heart
description: Location: Given by The Almighty after defeating [The Almight and the Spirits](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=525461) Effect: The enlightened attitude of one who knows all there is to know about battle

description: Location: Inside the treasure chest dropped by the [Menacing Monster](https://mapgenie.io/dragon-quest-vii/maps/present?locationIds=525465) Effect: A commitment to caring that means sacrificing anything and everything to come to another's aid

title: Vis Mager Heart
